description: Defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within the request processing pipeline, ensuring transactions are properly committed or rolled back based on success or failure.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for MediatR that manages database transactions for each request, ensuring atomicity.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request by starting a transaction, invoking the next delegate, then committing or rolling back the transaction based on success.
